signals.title: Puppet Show: "Peter Rabbit" (Зайчето Питър)
signals.reason: Beloved woodland animal classic brought to life on stage, ideal visual pacing and length for a 4-year-old.

signals.title: Kids' Magic Show with Stefan Sunkov
signals.location: The House of Magic, Kapana, Plovdiv
signals.reason: An interactive, close-up magic experience tailored to delight preschoolers in the heart of Kapana.

signals.title: Puppet Show: "The Choking Bear" (Задави се Меца)
signals.reason: A 40-minute energetic folk puppet show for ages 3+ that pairs seamlessly with a family visit to Stara Zagora Zoo.
signals.note: Confirmed on pierrot-bg.com and theatre.art.bg (within 70 min drive of Plovdiv).

signals.title: National Awakening Day Open-Air Concert
signals.reason: Festive, free open-air folk dance and music performance in an open setting where kids can dance around.

signals.title: Awakening Leaders' Day at the Natural History Museum
signals.reason: A family favorite venue featuring free entry for under-7s and a complimentary authentic fossil keepsake for young visitors.

signals.title: Halloween Circus Ivanov
signals.reason: Exciting, high-energy circus spectacle featuring acrobats, friendly animal characters, and a kids' costume contest.

signals.title: Puppet Show: "The Little Round Bun" (Житената питка)
signals.reason: Classic folktale filled with repetitive, catchy songs and colorful forest animal puppets that 4-year-olds easily follow.

signals.title: Byala Reka Ecotrail Hike
signals.location: Near Kalofer (~80 min drive from Plovdiv)
signals.reason: Gentle, secure wooden bridge trail crossing scenic river streams, directly matching family preferences for safe nature walks.

signals.title: Aviation Museum Krumovo Excursion
signals.location: Plovdiv Airport grounds, Krumovo (~15-20 min drive)
signals.reason: Spacious, flat outdoor airfield where toddlers can safely wander and marvel at full-sized airplanes and helicopters.

signals.title: Central Plovdiv Street Closures for Presidential Election Logistics
signals.location: ul. Hristo G. Danov (between Beethoven & Ruski), ul. Dr. Nikola Genadiev, ul. Knyaz Aleksandar Ekzarh, Blvd. Shesti Septemvri
signals.reason: Complete vehicular shut-down around Central District administration and lane closures on Shesti Septemvri to distribute voting materials.

signals.title: Citywide Municipal Prohibition of Alcohol Sales and Service for Election Day
signals.location: Citywide, Plovdiv (all dining venues, bars, and public areas)
signals.reason: Mayoral decree banning all retail sale, commercial table service, and public consumption of alcohol during presidential election polling.

signals.title: Matchday Traffic & Security Cordon: Lokomotiv Plovdiv vs. Slavia Sofia
signals.location: Stadion Lokomotiv (Lautur Park / Trakia border), Plovdiv
signals.reason: Top-tier Bulgarian league match causing major traffic bottlenecks, fan crowds, and police checkpoints along Lautur Park approaches.

signals.title: Plovdiv Low Emission Zone ('Small Ring') Central Driving Restrictions
signals.location: Central Plovdiv (perimeter of Blvd. Ruski, Blvd. Shesti Septemvri, Blvd. Tsar Boris III Obedinitel, Blvd. Hristo Botev)
signals.reason: Durable municipal regulation barring Category 1 petrol and Category 1–2 diesel vehicles from central streets without resident permits.

signals.title: New Operational Base and 8 European Direct Flight Routes at Plovdiv Airport
signals.reason: Major expansion of regular direct flights from Plovdiv to Western Europe (Germany, France, Spain, Netherlands, Ireland, etc.).

signals.title: Chamber Scene Plovdiv 2026: Reverie Classical Concert
signals.location: Concert Hall of AMDFA 'Prof. Asen Diamandiev', Old Town, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Intimate classical chamber music in a historic setting; completely non-verbal instrumental performance.

signals.title: Plovdiv Jazz Fest 2026 – Fall Edition
signals.location: Boris Hristov House of Culture, ul. William Gladstone 15, Plovdiv
signals.reason: The city's premier autumn music festival featuring top international and Bulgarian jazz musicians; purely instrumental and musical.

signals.title: 'Music of All Times' Classical Symphony Concert at the Bishop's Basilica
signals.location: Bishop's Basilica of Philippopolis, Blvd. Knyaginya Maria Luiza, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Symphonietta Vidin performs orchestral masterpieces directly inside the Roman mosaic basilica; entirely instrumental.

signals.title: LUCKY Cinema Center (LUCKY Дом на киното)
signals.when_text: Standing venue (daily afternoon and evening screenings)
signals.reason: The city's essential arthouse cinema, curating European cinema, festivals like Cinelibri, and original-audio screenings.
